basic_info.description: This rare, light-bathed, 2-level, house-like condo sits atop a handsome, Edwardian building between Lake Street and Sea Cliff, offering an enviable blend of city living - a neighborly vibe plus easy proximity to iconic natural and cultural treasures plus world class dining. Beautiful architectural details define this home: high, coved ceilings, wood-burning fireplace, hardwood floors, built-in cabinetry and well proportioned rooms, including the expansive living room. The sky-lit, well-appointed kitchen features stainless steel appliances, quartz counters, in-unit laundry and a large bay window that simultaneously nurtures your soul, potted herbs and orchids. Two generously sized bedrooms and a sunroom overlook the pretty shared backyard. Ascend the stairs to the pent room's ensuite primary bedroom and discover breathtaking views of the Bay, Golden Gate Bridge and Marin Headlands. A bright sanctuary by day, this space transcends into evening serenity with stunning sunsets and, if you open a window, the soothing sound of fog horns. There are 3 storage areas including 2 private rooms with windows to the backyard that add versatility (office? gym?) Garage parking for 1 car. Near the Presidio, Baker Beach, Land's End, Legion of Honor, Burkes School, Pearl, Aziza, Fiorella & more!
